failures.evidence: Pre-existing in Go at both ad909178 and a6ecbc12 (not caused by this pull request), found by the generated differential. Go's pmdoc.Parse against the headless engine (packages/dispatch/e2e/engine-tables.ts's engine, the one that draws comments, asks, messages and past versions), on the paragraph text: (1) unequal tilde runs: 'Plain ~a~~ text.' -> Go reads 'Plain a~ text.' (strike 'a', then '~') and stores 'Plain ~~a~~~ text.'; the engine reads 'Plain ~a~~ text.' unchanged. Same for '~~a~' (Go '~a', engine '~~a~'). So the same markdown in a document written through the API shows a struck word, and in a comment shows the tildes. (2) emphasis around a tilde: 'Plain b*~* text.' -> Go reads 'Plain b*~* text.' and stores 'Plain b\*~* text.'; the engine reads 'Plain b~ text.' (italic '~'). In a table, 'x ~(*~|_* y' class: Go strike '(*' where the engine reads '~(' and italic '~|_'. Searches 'strikethrough', 'strike', 'tilde', 'single tilde' on Dispatch find no issue (2026-10-27 00:35Z). A possible third, judged by the architect against INFRA-531 (A web address after punctuation is a link in a comment and plain text in a document): 'See <http://e.test/a\\b now.' -> Go reads one backslash and stores 'See <http\://e.test/a\b now.'; the engine keeps both backslashes and links the address. Reproduce: the throwaway harness in $TMPDIR/infra172-test/harness (zz_tester_fuzz_test.go TestTesterText with TESTER_TEXT_IN=$TMPDIR/infra172-test/text/docs.json, zz-tester-text.ts in packages/dispatch/e2e); outputs in $TMPDIR/infra172-test/text/{go,eng,go-base}.json. Needed: drafts for the architect to file, rows in the assessment's table, and the count corrected, before the merge closes INFRA-172.
